Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** 2017 Exoplanet Archive News – https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/2017news.html  

**Evidence:**  
The page lists the planets that were added to the NASA Exoplanet Archive during 2017, grouped by the date of the news release.  Each bullet list records the planet name, the host star name (when distinct), and a link to the planet’s “Confirmed Planet Overview” page.  The text is reproduced verbatim with the planet names and dates:

* **December 21 2017** – “Five New Planets: HD 176986 b, c; K2‑18 c; GJ 3942 b; PSR J2322‑2650 b.”  
* **December 14 2017** – “KOI‑351 i (Kepler‑90 i), Kepler‑80 g, K2‑139 b.”  
* **December 1 2017** – “HD 76920 b; HD 40956 b; HD 111591 b; HD 113996 b; OGLE‑2016‑BLG‑1190L b; OGLE‑2016‑BLG‑0613L AB b.”  
* **November 17 2017** – “Ross 128 b; K2‑136 b, c, d; K2‑137 b; Kepler‑1652 b; Kepler‑1653 b; NGTS‑1 b.”  
* **November 2 2017** – “MASCARA‑1 b; K2‑135 b, c, d; KELT‑20 b.”  
* **October 27 2017** – “K2‑133 b, c, d; OGLE‑2013‑BLG‑0132L b; OGLE‑2013‑BLG‑1721L b; WASP‑151 b; WASP‑153 b; WASP‑156 b; HD 34445 c, d, e, f, g.”  
* **October 19 2017** – “K2‑131 b; K2‑132 b; GJ 1148 c.”  
* **October 5 2017** – “K2‑116 b; K2‑117 b, c; K2‑118 b; K2‑119 b; K2‑120 b, c; K2‑121 b; K2‑122 b; K2‑123 b; K2‑124 b; K2‑125 b; K2‑126 b; K2‑127 b; K2‑128 b; K2‑129 b; K2‑130 b.”  
* **September 28 2017** – “OGLE‑2016‑BLG‑0263L b; HD 208897 b; GJ 625 b.”  
* **September 15 2017** – “CoRoT ID 223977153 b; MOA‑2012‑BLG‑006L b; K2‑114 b; K2‑115 b.”  
* **August 24 2017** – “YZ Cet b; YZ Cet c; YZ Cet d.”  
* **August 17 2017** – “tau Cet g; tau Cet h; tau Cet e; tau Cet f; WASP‑91 b; WASP‑105 b; WASP‑107 b.”  
* **July 28 2017** – “WASP‑167 b/KELT‑13 b; K2‑113 b; MXB 1658‑298 b.”  
* **July 13 2017** – “HIP 65426 b.”  
* **June 29 2017** – “TYC 4282‑605‑1 b.”  
* **June 22 2017** – “MOA 2012‑BLG‑505L b.”  
* **June 15 2017** – “HD 27894 c; HD 27894 d; BD+03 2562 b; HD 177565 b.”  
* **June 8 2017** – “HD 3167 d; HD 20794 e.”  
* **June 5 2017** – “KELT‑9 b.”  
* **June 1 2017** – “Kepler‑1650 b; Kepler‑1651 b.”  
* **May 18 2017** – “K2‑110 b; MOA 2016‑BLG‑227L b.”  
* **May 10 2017** – “KELT‑11 b; K2‑111 b; OGLE‑2016‑BLG‑1195L b.”  
* **April 27 2017** – “LHS 1140 b; Kepler‑1649 b; KELT‑12 b; KELT‑18 b; HIP 67537 b; Qatar‑3 b; Qatar‑4 b; Qatar‑5 b.”  
* **April 13 2017** – “HAT‑P‑67 b; Kepler‑19 d; Kepler‑150 f.”  
* **March 30 2017** – “Kepler‑20 g; NGC 2682 Sand 978 b; GJ 3138 b,c,d; GJ 3323 b,c; GJ 273 b,c; GJ 3293 d,e.”  
* **March 23 2017** – “HATS‑22 b; HATS‑23 b; HATS‑24 b.”  
* **March 3 2017** – “HD 17674 b; HD 29021 b; HD 42012 b; HD 106315 b,c.”  
* **February 22 2017** – “TRAPPIST‑1 b,c,d,e,f,g,h.”  
* **February 9 2017** – “K2‑108 b; KELT‑16 b.”  
* **February 2 2017** – “K2‑107 b; WASP‑53 b,c; WASP‑81 b; TAP 26 b.”  
* **January 26 2017** – “K2‑106 b,c.”  
* **January 12 2017** – “K2‑105 b.”  

The page also contains many bullet‑point hyperlinks to each planet’s overview, e.g.:

* `https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/cgi-bin/DisplayOverview/nph-DisplayOverview?objname=hd+176986+b&type=CONFIRMED_PLANET`  
* `https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/cgi-bin/DisplayOverview/nph-DisplayOverview?objname=k2-18+c&type=CONFIRMED_PLANET`  
* `https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/cgi-bin/DisplayOverview/nph-DisplayOverview?objname=pgj+3942+b&type=CONFIRMED_PLANET`  
* `https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/cgi-bin/DisplayOverview/nph-DisplayOverview?objname=psr+j2322-2650+b&type=CONFIRMED_PLANET`  
…and so on for every planet listed above.

**Missing:**  
The page does **not** contain any of the following values for the listed planets:  
* Planet radius (or  R⊕)  
* Discovery method (e.g., transit, radial‑velocity, etc.)  
* Orbital period (days)  
* Host star spectral type (e.g., M‑type).  

Thus, the criteria of the original question (smaller radius than Earth, transit discovery, period > 1 day, orbiting an M‑type star) cannot be fulfilled with the evidence on this page alone.

**Next links:**  
All of the hyperlinks that point to pages of the form  
`https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/cgi-bin/DisplayOverview/nph-DisplayOverview?objname=<planet>&type=CONFIRMED_PLANET`  
lead to the planet’s “Confirmed Planet Overview” page, which contains the planet’s radius, discovery method, orbital period, and host star properties.  
Additionally, the link to the general “Confirmed Planets” interactive table  
`https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/cgi-bin/TblView/nph-tblView?app=ExoTbls&config=planets`  
can be used to query those same parameters for each planet in bulk.
